items.title: thebodytheory01-commits/final-round-ai-desktop: Final Round AI Desktop: Real-Time Interview Coaching, Speech Transcription, and Response Sug
items.summary: Final Round AI Desktop is a Windows application designed to provide real-time interview coaching, live speech transcription, and suggested responses during video calls. It runs local-first speech-to-text inference and features a concealed overlay window that remains hidden from shared meeting feeds. Users can connect it to interchangeable language-model providers through a unified settings panel.
items.why_it_matters: It offers job seekers a private, local-first tool for real-time AI assistance during video interviews.

items.title: SenpaiSpide664/ai-visual-prompt-cookbook: AI Visual Prompt Cookbook: Reusable JSON Style Prompts for Consistent Image Generation
items.summary: The AI Visual Prompt Cookbook is a structured dataset of reusable style definitions for AI image generation, formatted as JSON templates compatible with tools like Midjourney, GPT Image, and Nano Banana Pro. Each package contains a parameterized prompt specification alongside preview assets to ensure consistent visual styles across different subjects. It is openly accessible and updated weekly for researchers and practitioners.
items.why_it_matters: It provides a standardized dataset of reusable styles to help maintain visual consistency across various image synthesis workflows.

items.title: duzhenxun/pop-agent: PopAgent local web UI for your coding agents: watch the reasoning stream, cut in with a correction mid-turn, manage mod
items.summary: PopAgent is a local web user interface designed for coding agents, allowing users to watch reasoning streams, manage models and tools, and make corrections mid-turn. It operates directly on the engine's local JSONL files without requiring a cloud database or separate user accounts. The platform also integrates features like live voice transcription, quick commands, and response text-to-speech.
items.why_it_matters: It gives developers a transparent, local-first web interface to monitor and interact with various coding agent engines.

items.title: LayoutRecall: Preserving Appearance in Multi-Round 3D Layout-Controlled Image Editing
items.summary: The authors introduce LayoutRecall, a multi-round 3D layout-controlled image editor designed to preserve an object's appearance when it reappears after being occluded or moving out of view. The method uses Box-Surface Latent Memory to store image latents on 3D box faces and Geometry-Aligned Memory Conditioning to supply retrieved tokens to a FLUX.2 editor. Additionally, they introduce LayoutLoop, a new benchmark with calibrated layouts for testing multi-round 3D edits.
items.why_it_matters: It improves the consistency of object appearances across multi-round 3D layout-controlled image editing tasks.
